tools.name: accept_checkin_proposal
tools.summary: Applies the plan change autopilot proposed for a check-in as a new revision of each plan behind the day types, without sending feedback.

tools.name: accept_join_request
tools.summary: Accepts a join request: the person becomes a client with status invited.

tools.name: add_bloodwork
tools.summary: Adds a dated bloodwork panel to a client: takenOn (the day the blood was drawn, not in the future), optional labName and notes, optional documentId of the lab report among the client's documents, and results: per marker (a key from list_bloodwork markers) the value as printed, the unit (default the marker's usual unit) and the lab's reference range refLow and refHigh.

tools.name: add_cardio_entry
tools.summary: Records cardio done without a watch: a day, minutes and an activity type.

tools.name: add_client_event
tools.summary: Adds a date to a client's timeline, such as a show, a photoshoot or a holiday.

tools.name: add_client_note
tools.summary: Adds a note on a client.

tools.name: add_follow_up
tools.summary: Writes a follow-up for this client, for instance "check next week: response to +50 g carbs".

tools.name: add_form_question
tools.summary: Adds one question at the end or at a position.

tools.name: add_meal
tools.summary: Adds a meal to a meal plan.

tools.name: add_meal_option
tools.summary: Adds a dish to a meal: a copy of a recipe scaled to servings, foods, or numbers entered by hand.

tools.name: add_supplement_to_plan
tools.summary: Adds one supplement to a client's plan as a new version from effectiveOn (same default and future_version rule as set_supplement_plan), keeping every other line.

tools.name: add_workout_to_program
tools.summary: Puts a copy of a library workout, or a new empty workout, on a day of a week.

tools.name: adjust_peak_week_day
tools.summary: Adjusts one peak week day from today on, such as carbs +50 g or water -0.5 L: numbers are added to the plan and negative takes away; dayTypeKey replaces the day type.

tools.name: answer_coach_question
tools.summary: Adds an answer (or a follow-up from the asker) to a question thread and notifies the other person.

tools.name: apply_peak_week
tools.summary: Plans the client's peak week for a show date from a template or from days sent here.

tools.name: apply_plan_change
tools.summary: Applies a move such as +25 g carbs to the meal plans behind the chosen day types, as a new revision of each with a one-line summary.

tools.name: apply_sequence
tools.summary: Enrolls a client in the published version.

tools.name: archive_automation_rule
tools.summary: Archives an automation and stops its enrollments.

tools.name: archive_client
tools.summary: Archives a client.

tools.name: archive_exercise
tools.summary: Archives a company exercise.

tools.name: archive_form
tools.summary: Archives a form so it cannot be assigned.

tools.name: archive_workout
tools.summary: Archives a company workout.

tools.name: ask_coach
tools.summary: Asks a colleague or the owner for input on this client, for instance "what do you think of +50 g carbs here?".

tools.name: assign_form_to_clients
tools.summary: Assigns one form to up to 100 clients on the same schedule and notifies each.

tools.name: assign_habits
tools.summary: Gives a client up to 20 habits at once.

tools.name: assign_plan_set
tools.summary: Copies a plan set's plans into a client and replaces the client's day-type setup.

tools.name: assign_program
tools.summary: Puts a program on the client: copies its workouts onto dates (Calendar, day 1 of the chosen week falls on startDate) or onto the end of the list (Fixed).

tools.name: bulk_update_tasks
tools.summary: Updates many tasks at once.

tools.name: check_client_email
tools.summary: Reports whether an email is new, a client here, or already on the team.

tools.name: choose_meal_option
tools.summary: Picks an option, or a recipe with servings, for a meal on one date.

tools.name: clear_day_override
tools.summary: Removes the override on one date so training and rules decide again.

tools.name: clear_micronutrient_target
tools.summary: Clears this client's own target for one nutrient, so the reference target applies again.

tools.name: close_follow_up
tools.summary: Closes a follow-up and records when, by whom and on which check-in (checkinId, the one being reviewed).

tools.name: compare_checkins
tools.summary: Puts 2 to 4 sent check-ins side by side by question key, with the change from first to last and the photos per pose.

tools.name: complete_task
tools.summary: Marks a task done.

tools.name: confirm_food_log_draft
tools.summary: Saves a text draft as entries.

tools.name: copy_food_log
tools.summary: Copies a day's entries, or only the listed meals, to another date as new entries.

tools.name: copy_off_product
tools.summary: Copies an Open Food Facts product into your food library per 100 g or ml, with its barcode and serving, and returns the food.

tools.name: create_automation_rule
tools.summary: Saves an automation as a draft.

tools.name: create_client
tools.summary: Adds a client with access invite or later.

tools.name: create_day_type
tools.summary: Creates a company day type such as Legs or High carb.

tools.name: create_exercise
tools.summary: Creates a company exercise with at least one primary muscle.

tools.name: create_form
tools.summary: Creates a form at revision 1, optionally with questions.

tools.name: create_included_block
tools.summary: Includes a section template (sectionId, any revision) automatically in every workout of a day type (dayTypeId) or with a training tag (tagId), at the start or the end.

tools.name: create_lead
tools.summary: Adds a lead by hand, for example after a call or a message.

tools.name: create_nutrition_plan
tools.summary: Creates a meal or macros plan for a client, empty or as a copy of another of their plans.

tools.name: create_program
tools.summary: Creates a Calendar or Fixed program with one empty first week.

tools.name: create_quiz
tools.summary: Creates a quiz for the company's public pages: 3 to 8 multiple-choice questions whose answers give points to 2 to 4 outcomes, each outcome with a result text and a next step (apply, call or none).

tools.name: create_supplement
tools.summary: Adds a supplement to the company library.

tools.name: create_switch_import
tools.summary: Uploads an export from another coaching tool (Kahunas, Trainerize, HubFit, TrueCoach, Everfit, PT Distinction, Google Sheets or any CSV, XLSX, JSON or ZIP of CSVs) and reads it.

tools.name: create_task
tools.summary: Creates a task for the company.

tools.name: create_workout
tools.summary: Creates a library workout (or a section template with ownerKind section) from blocks of lines and sets.

tools.name: decide_style_proposal
tools.summary: Accepts or rejects one of the caller's own proposals.

tools.name: decline_join_request
tools.summary: Declines a join request: it is closed as cancelled and the person is not emailed.

tools.name: delete_food_log_entry
tools.summary: Deletes one entry.

tools.name: delete_included_block
tools.summary: Stops including a reusable block.

tools.name: delete_metric_entry
tools.summary: Deletes one day's entry.

tools.name: delete_session
tools.summary: Deletes a session and recomputes the records it affected.

tools.name: draft_checkin_feedback
tools.summary: Saves feedback on a sent check-in as a draft for the coach.

tools.name: draft_content
tools.summary: Writes a text for a theme in the coach's voice and files it as a draft on the content calendar: caption, reel script, carousel outline, newsletter section or myth of the week.

tools.name: draft_save_message
tools.summary: Drafts a short chat message that checks in on a client at risk, in the coach's own voice and the client's language.

tools.name: duplicate_exercise
tools.summary: Saves a shared or company exercise as a new company exercise you can edit.

tools.name: duplicate_form
tools.summary: Copies a form's current revision under a new name.

tools.name: edit_client_workout
tools.summary: Saves this client's copy of a workout as a new revision and marks it customised.

tools.name: end_life_mode
tools.summary: Ends a life mode now: numbers are judged again from today.

tools.name: find_clients
tools.summary: Finds clients by figures we hold, from a typed list of filters that must all hold.

tools.name: find_clients_missing_habits
tools.summary: Lists clients whose habit completion over the last days is below a percentage, lowest first.

tools.name: finish_call
tools.summary: Finishes a call.

tools.name: flag_for_call
tools.summary: Adds something to the client's next call: a check-in answer, a message, a chart point, a food day or a note.

tools.name: get_activity_summary
tools.summary: Returns a client's steps, active energy, sleep, resting heart rate and workouts for a week or month, each compared with the period before, the recovery values per day (HRV, sleep stages, bed and wake time, respiratory rate, blood oxygen, VO2 max), and the cardio minutes and sessions per week from watch workouts, Evolvix training and entries.

tools.name: get_automation
tools.summary: Returns one automation and its steps.

tools.name: get_business_stats
tools.summary: Reads the numbers that run a coaching business for one company, over a rolling period in the company's time zone: clients (active, paused, archived, new and lost, churn, lifetime, twelve months), coach performance (check-ins due, received, reviewed on time, feedback speed, waiting and late; unread chat and first-reply speed), client outcomes against their phase (cut or bulk) with check-in and daily-log rates, revenue (monthly recurring revenue of paying subscriptions with trials counted apart, paid and failed payments; null for a connected app without the payments:read scope) and leads (join-link sign-ups, questionnaires, sources).

tools.name: get_call_brief
tools.summary: Returns the agenda of a call with a client as data: the header, what changed since the last call, the latest check-in with the answers that moved most, adherence, open questions, flagged items and the last call's agreements.

tools.name: get_checkin
tools.summary: Returns one check-in with the questions of its revision, the answers, comments and feedback.

tools.name: get_checkin_brief
tools.summary: Returns the first read of one sent check-in for the coach: plan week and phase, weights, last plan changes, energy balance, this week's numbers, what is coming, the client's open questions and the flags worth a look.

tools.name: get_checkin_day
tools.summary: Returns the coach's check-in day: the clients whose check-in is due on the date with their status (waiting for the client, received, reviewed, or sent with feedback), the counts on top, the check-ins from the last 14 days that still wait for review in their own late list (longest late first), and next, the first check-in to review (late ones before today's).

tools.name: get_checkin_day_summary
tools.summary: Summarises a check-in day: for each active client whose check-in was reviewed on the date, whether feedback went out, the plan changes dated from the check-in on (calories, program, training rhythm, steps, cardio, phase) and the follow-ups opened and closed that day.

tools.name: get_checkin_question_trend
tools.summary: Returns one question's answers across a form's sent check-ins, oldest first.

tools.name: get_checkin_week
tools.summary: Returns a daily check-in form as a week grid: a row per question, a cell per day, and per question the week's average, most common answer or count set against the week before.

tools.name: get_client
tools.summary: Returns one client, including status, coaches, profile, and week.

tools.name: get_client_cycle_phase
tools.summary: Returns only the phase word of a client's current cycle block (BLAST, CRUISE, TRT, OFF, PCT, PREP, or null) and the date the next bloodwork is planned.

tools.name: get_client_overview
tools.summary: Reads one client's overview for a date and a week.

tools.name: get_client_peak_week
tools.summary: Returns the client's peak week: the one running today, else the next, else the last.

tools.name: get_client_risk
tools.summary: Returns one client's dropout risk: the score, the level, a reason line for each signal that counted with its points, any snooze, and the last 30 days of scores.

tools.name: get_client_timeline
tools.summary: Returns a client's timeline: the phases that touch the range and the events inside it, and where the client stands today.

tools.name: get_client_week_timeline
tools.summary: Returns a client's weeks of the last 12 months, oldest first, from the first week with data to the current one, as a coach keeps them in a sheet.

tools.name: get_client_workout
tools.summary: Returns one client workout with its full document: blocks, lines, sets, and alternatives.

tools.name: get_coach_today
tools.summary: Reads the coach's today page for one company.

tools.name: get_company_features
tools.summary: Lists every feature switch of the active company in plain groups (check-ins and coaching, AI, growth and marketing, client app, Claude and privacy): whether it is on, off, always on or chosen per coach, per client, per Claude app or per browser, who may change it, whether it sends something to clients or to the AI service, and which switch it waits for (blockedBy).

tools.name: get_day_calendar
tools.summary: Returns the client's resolved day types for a date range: the type, the fallback chain nutrition uses, and why.

tools.name: get_day_rules
tools.summary: Returns the weekday and date rules used on days training does not decide.

tools.name: get_exercise
tools.summary: Returns one exercise with muscles, images, and where it is used.

tools.name: get_exercise_facets
tools.summary: Counts the filter choices (type, level, equipment, primary muscle) over the exercises you can use.

tools.name: get_exercise_history
tools.summary: Returns one exercise's history: best weight, estimated 1RM, volume and session tiles, a chart series per day with record markers, and the set log per session.

tools.name: get_fixed_program
tools.summary: Returns a Fixed client's workouts in order with done, next, upcoming, or skipped, which one is next up, and sessions done outside the list.

tools.name: get_food_log
tools.summary: Returns one day's food log: entries, totals, per-meal groups, the day's snapshot target, the note, skips, and choices.

tools.name: get_form
tools.summary: Returns a form with the questions of its current revision, or of a past revision when revision is given.

tools.name: get_grocery_list
tools.summary: Returns the grocery list for a date range: foods from each day's meal plan summed with units, grouped by shop category, with ticks and the client's own items.

tools.name: get_habit_summary
tools.summary: Returns the week table: one row per habit, one cell per day, plus the average.

tools.name: get_import_status
tools.summary: Returns one import: its status (draft, queued, running, done, failed, undone), progress, the mapping, the preview while it is a draft, and the report once it has finished.

tools.name: get_lead
tools.summary: Returns one lead with its timeline (status changes, assignments and notes, newest first).

tools.name: get_lead_funnel
tools.summary: Follows the leads created in the last 30 or 90 days: per source and per coach, how many leads, contacted, calls booked, won (signed up), lost, churned since, and the revenue paid so far by the clients they became (minor units of the company currency).

tools.name: get_marker_trend
tools.summary: Returns one marker over time for a client: every value with the lab's reference range at that draw (flag above or below only against that range), in the unit of the newest value (earlier values in another unit are counted in otherUnit and left out), plus the plan's phases (cut, bulk and so on) and, for the coach in a company with the cycle tracker on, the cycle phase words (BLAST, CRUISE, TRT, OFF, PCT, PREP) and never a compound or a dose.

tools.name: get_me
tools.summary: Returns the signed-in profile.

tools.name: get_messages
tools.summary: Lists a page of messages in a relationship, oldest first within the page.

tools.name: get_metric_trend
tools.summary: Returns one metric's entries, open goal, and summary: first, last, change, percent change, average, and previousAverage.

tools.name: get_metric_week
tools.summary: Returns the week table: every tracked metric by day, the week's average, and the change from the week before.

tools.name: get_micronutrient_day
tools.summary: Returns one day's 26 vitamins and minerals: intake from the food log, the daily target from the company's EFSA or USDA table by the client's sex and age (B1 and B3 per MJ of the day's calorie target under EFSA), the upper limit, and a status.

tools.name: get_micronutrient_summary
tools.summary: Returns each vitamin and mineral over up to 31 days: how many logged days it was met, low, over the upper limit or incomplete, the average intake and percentage, and a status per day.

tools.name: get_mini_checkin
tools.summary: Returns one mini check-in laid out as a brief: who, when it must be answered by, every answer in the order of the template and the ids of the photos the visitor allowed.

tools.name: get_nutrition_day
tools.summary: Returns one day's nutrition: the day type, which plan applies after fallback, the target, and the meals.

tools.name: get_nutrition_plan
tools.summary: Returns a plan with every food, unit, and nutrient per line, dish, meal, and day, compared with the client's targets.

tools.name: get_nutrition_settings
tools.summary: Returns how the client logs food and what nutrition features they see.

tools.name: get_nutrition_setup
tools.summary: Returns the nutrition pattern for a relationship.

tools.name: get_nutrition_summary
tools.summary: Returns the last days up to today with the day type, the target the client saw, and what was logged, plus averages over logged days.

tools.name: get_onboarding_draft
tools.summary: Returns the AI draft of a new client's starting setup, or null when there is none: its status (queued, running, ready, blocked, failed, released), why it is blocked, which sections are accepted or released, and the proposal with every food, supplement, exercise and program named and every total worked out.

tools.name: get_owner_brief
tools.summary: Reads the Monday brief for the company's owners, one stored brief per Monday (week).

tools.name: get_prep_timeline
tools.summary: Returns the prep timeline of a client with a show ahead (a peak week, a peak_week phase, or a show date set with set_stage_target): the weeks out, and for staff the projection of the 7-day average weight to the show at the current rate (the last four weeks) and at the rate the stage weight needs.

tools.name: get_prepared_checkin
tools.summary: Returns what autopilot prepared for one sent check-in, for the coach only: the AI draft of the feedback when the coach switched drafts on (state says why there is none), the plan change the fixed rules propose with its preview on the plans as they stand now (macro, grams, day types, the one-sentence reason, the changed food lines, the day totals before and after, and the plan revisions to pass as bases), the follow-up that goes with it, and noProposal, the reason when nothing is proposed.

tools.name: get_program
tools.summary: Returns a program with its settings, weeks, and placed workouts (name, counts, day type, estimated duration) and the revision to send back.

tools.name: get_quiz_results
tools.summary: Returns what one quiz brought in: visitors, finished quizzes, leads, and per outcome how often it came up and how many of those people left an email address.

tools.name: get_recovery_trend
tools.summary: Returns a client's recovery from the health app: sleep, resting heart rate, HRV and steps for the 7 days ending on date, each against the client's own average of the 4 weeks before (baseline and usual range), with the daily points of both periods and the recovery signals that are on: resting heart rate 5 bpm or more above baseline on 5 or more days, HRV 15% or more below baseline on 5 or more days, sleep under 6 hours on average over 5 or more nights.

tools.name: get_referral_link
tools.summary: Returns the client's personal referral link with its visits, leads and won count and the reward the company promises.

tools.name: get_rescue_settings
tools.summary: Reads the company's settings for celebrating wins (celebrateMode: off, suggest or auto) and for the missed check-in rescue (rescueEnabled, rescueAfterHours, and rescueChat for an extra chat message).

tools.name: get_session
tools.summary: Returns one session with its exercises, sets, previous performance, current records, and the records it set.

tools.name: get_style_guide
tools.summary: Reads a coach's style guide: language, structure, words to use and avoid, and good and bad examples.

tools.name: get_supplement_adherence
tools.summary: Returns how many scheduled intakes a client took, skipped or left open per day and per supplement over a range up to today.

tools.name: get_supplement_day
tools.summary: Returns what a client takes on one day, grouped by moment in day order and resolved for that day's day type: training days include the workout moments.

tools.name: get_supplement_plan
tools.summary: Returns a client's supplement plan: sections of lines, each a library supplement with an amount (or a range with amountMax), a unit, a note, product links and discount code, and the moments to take it (on waking, morning, a meal, every meal, afternoon, pre, intra or post workout, evening, before bed with minutes before, or a clock time) on every day, training days or rest days.

tools.name: get_todays_habits
tools.summary: Returns the habits due today in the client's time zone, with state, amount and streak.

tools.name: get_training_calendar
tools.summary: Returns each date of a range (at most 62 days) with its day type, its client workouts, and the sessions performed.

tools.name: get_training_logbook
tools.summary: Returns the client's log book, newest week first: per workout name, each exercise with its sessions week by week (load x reps per set, the top set, volume, and a trend against the session before).

tools.name: get_training_settings
tools.summary: Returns the client's training mode and what they may do: how far ahead they see, and whether they may move, skip, or swap.

tools.name: get_training_stats
tools.summary: Returns training statistics for a period against the equal period before: KPIs, weighted sets per muscle, daily upper, lower, and core sets, a trained-day calendar, and record cards.

tools.name: get_workout_template
tools.summary: Returns the current revision of a workout with blocks, lines, sets, alternatives, and estimates.

tools.name: import_clients
tools.summary: Adds up to 200 clients.

tools.name: import_metric_history
tools.summary: Imports up to 2000 dated measurements for one client, such as daily weights from a spreadsheet.

tools.name: interpret_review_note
tools.summary: Turns what the coach said about a sent check-in into typed actions, without applying or sending anything: the plan change they asked for (macro, grams, day types) with its preview on the plans as they stand now and a fingerprint, a follow-up, points to praise or mention in the message, whether they said to send, and problems naming what was not understood or cannot be done.

tools.name: link_session_to_workout
tools.summary: Answers a finished ad hoc session's plannedMatch: clientWorkoutId counts it as that planned workout (done, and the day takes its day type) after the client or coach says yes; dismiss true records a no and stops asking.

tools.name: list_at_risk_clients
tools.summary: Lists the clients most likely to quit, highest score first, each with the reasons behind the score in the caller's language.

tools.name: list_automation_actions
tools.summary: Lists the actions an automation can run.

tools.name: list_automation_templates
tools.summary: Lists sequence templates a coach can start from.

tools.name: list_automation_triggers
tools.summary: Lists the events that can start an automation.

tools.name: list_automations
tools.summary: Lists automations in the company.

tools.name: list_bloodwork
tools.summary: Lists a client's bloodwork panels, newest first: the date of the draw, the lab, notes, and per marker the value, unit and the reference range the lab printed, with flag above or below when the value is outside that range (the lab's range only; there is no other judgement).

tools.name: list_chat_references
tools.summary: Lists what a message can point at, one type at a time.

tools.name: list_checkin_assignments
tools.summary: Lists the forms assigned to a client with their schedule, next due check-in and compliance (sent and due; a missed check-in before the client's start date does not count, nor does a skipped one).

tools.name: list_checkin_inbox
tools.summary: Lists sent check-ins to review across the clients the caller may review: pending oldest first, reviewed newest first.

tools.name: list_client_checkins
tools.summary: Lists a client's check-ins newest first.

tools.name: list_client_enrollments
tools.summary: Lists automations enrolled for one client.

tools.name: list_client_metrics
tools.summary: Lists the metrics a client tracks with the latest value and open goal.

tools.name: list_client_notes
tools.summary: Lists staff notes on a client, including private ones.

tools.name: list_client_tags
tools.summary: Lists the company's client tags and how many clients use each.

tools.name: list_client_wins
tools.summary: Lists the wins of the caller's clients that are worth a congratulation: a PR on a lift, a logging streak of weeks, a weight milestone toward the goal, 12/26/52 weeks coached, a finished phase, a first week fully on plan.

tools.name: list_clients
tools.summary: Lists clients in the caller's company, with status, tags, and week labels.

tools.name: list_coach_questions
tools.summary: Lists the questions between staff that the caller asked or was asked, newest first, with the replies.

tools.name: list_content_calendar
tools.summary: Lists the content calendar: items dated within from and to (at most about a year apart), plus the undated ideas and drafts unless undated is false.

tools.name: list_content_themes
tools.summary: Lists what clients struggle with in a week: anonymous themes found in the week's check-in answers (and chat when the company allowed it), each shared by at least three clients and shown as a band (clientsAtLeast 3, 5 or 10, never an exact count), with a paraphrased example and how the coach answered.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.summary: Lists conversations with unread counts for the signed-in person.

tools.name: list_day_types
tools.summary: Lists day types: the built-in training and rest plus the company's own.

tools.name: list_enrollments
tools.summary: Lists clients enrolled in one automation.

tools.name: list_follow_ups
tools.summary: Lists the follow-ups a coach wrote for this client to look at in a later check-in: open ones first, oldest first (overdue ones stay), then the newest closed ones when withClosed is true.

tools.name: list_form_templates
tools.summary: Lists the platform check-in and questionnaire templates with their question labels.

tools.name: list_forms
tools.summary: Lists the company's check-in and questionnaire forms with question count and active assignments.

tools.name: list_habit_templates
tools.summary: Lists habit templates: the company's own and the platform's, with how many clients use each.

tools.name: list_included_blocks
tools.summary: Lists the reusable blocks of your company: section templates included automatically at the start or end of every workout with a day type or a training tag.

tools.name: list_join_requests
tools.summary: Lists the people who signed up through a join link and wait for a coach to accept them, newest first, with the check-in that holds their questionnaire answers.

tools.name: list_lead_magnets
tools.summary: Lists the free calculators (maintenance calories, macros, protein, weeks to show) and quizzes the company has on its public pages, which are on, and per magnet how many visitors came, how many finished a quiz and how many left an email address (leads).

tools.name: list_leads
tools.summary: Lists the leads: people who asked about coaching but are not clients yet, newest first (the waitlist oldest first).

tools.name: list_life_modes
tools.summary: Lists a client's life modes: periods of travel, illness, holiday, competition week or other time off in which their numbers are not judged.

tools.name: list_metrics
tools.summary: Lists the company's metric catalog: built-in metrics and the company's own.

tools.name: list_mini_checkins
tools.summary: Lists the free mini check-ins that visitors filled in, newest first, with the stated goal and whether the coach already answered.

tools.name: list_missed_checkins
tools.summary: Lists check-ins whose window closed unsent in the last 30 days, most overdue first.

tools.name: list_my_due_checkins
tools.summary: Lists the signed-in client's open and upcoming check-ins across their open coaching relationships, soonest first.

tools.name: list_my_relationships
tools.summary: Lists the open coaching relationships of the signed-in person, with the enabled modules of each.

tools.name: list_nutrition_plans
tools.summary: Lists a client's nutrition plans with planned totals, option ranges, and the day types that use each.

tools.name: list_owner_briefs
tools.summary: Lists the Mondays that have a stored brief, newest first, with whether the caller dismissed that brief from their Today, and this week's Monday.

tools.name: list_peak_week_templates
tools.summary: Lists the company's peak week templates: the plan of each day relative to the show (offset 0 is the show day, -7 a week before): day type, macro changes in grams, water, sodium, potassium, fibre, training focus, cardio, posing and notes.

tools.name: list_performed_exercises
tools.summary: Lists the exercises the client has logged, most recent first, with the last date and the number of sessions.

tools.name: list_personal_records
tools.summary: Returns the current record of each kind per exercise, and with exerciseId every record event too.

tools.name: list_plan_sets
tools.summary: Lists plan sets: library plans and targets per day type, assigned together.

tools.name: list_post_ideas
tools.summary: Lists the caller's open post ideas made from patterns across their own active clients (logging, habits, check-in streaks, personal records, common topics, calorie hit-rate).

tools.name: list_practices
tools.summary: Lists practices in the caller's company.

tools.name: list_program_assignments
tools.summary: Lists the programs on the client with their dates, status, and how many of their workouts are done.

tools.name: list_program_copies
tools.summary: Lists client copies of the program's workouts with whether each is performed, customised, or eligible for a push.

tools.name: list_programs
tools.summary: Lists the programs of your company with week, workout, and assigned-client counts, plus shared samples when asked.

tools.name: list_question_colleagues
tools.summary: Lists the colleagues the caller can ask about this client: the staff who coach this client plus the company's owners and admins, without the caller.

tools.name: list_referrals
tools.summary: Lists the clients who have a personal referral link, with the visits, leads and won clients each one brought and the number of rewards still to hand over, plus the reward the company promises.

tools.name: list_saved_replies
tools.summary: Lists personal and shared saved replies for the caller.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.summary: Lists the client's workout sessions, newest first, with sets, volume, difficulty, and the number of records each set.

tools.name: list_style_proposals
tools.summary: Lists the caller's waiting style-guide proposals: one rule each, with the reason and how many edited drafts it comes from.

tools.name: list_supplements
tools.summary: Lists the company's supplement library: name, brand, default unit, category, discount code and product links, with how many clients' plans list each.

tools.name: list_switch_imports
tools.summary: Lists earlier imports with their status and report.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.summary: Lists tasks the caller can see, with overdue, today, upcoming, and no-date counts.

tools.name: list_team
tools.summary: Lists teammates with status, client count, last activity, and pending invitations.

tools.name: list_win_back_candidates
tools.summary: Lists past clients whose coaching stopped 3 to 9 months ago (paused, ended or archived) and who have not been written to for that window.

tools.name: list_workouts
tools.summary: Lists library workouts (or section templates) of your company and the shared samples, with filters and a total.

tools.name: log_food
tools.summary: Logs foods, recipes, or quick adds to one meal.

tools.name: log_food_from_text
tools.summary: Turns a description such as "2 eggs, toast and coffee" into a draft of matched foods.

tools.name: log_habit
tools.summary: Logs a habit for one day.

tools.name: log_metrics
tools.summary: Logs several metrics for one day in one call.

tools.name: log_planned_meal
tools.summary: Logs a plan meal as eaten: every line of the day's chosen option, or the default option when none was chosen, scaled by portion from 0.25 to 2.

tools.name: log_supplement_intake
tools.summary: Ticks one scheduled intake of a day as taken or skipped, or clears it with open.

tools.name: log_workout
tools.summary: Logs a finished workout after the fact in one call: exercises with the sets as performed, all counted as done (a set may carry partialReps, part-range reps after its full reps; they never count in reps, volume or records).

tools.name: make_transformation_post
tools.summary: Makes a branded before and after post from a client's progress photos: one picture per format (square, feed, story) and, with reel true, a short video, all with the company logo.

tools.name: mark_checkins_reviewed
tools.summary: Marks up to 100 sent check-ins as reviewed, or back to pending with reviewed false.

tools.name: mark_coaching_context
tools.summary: Marks a client note as coaching context (on true) or takes the mark off (on false).

tools.name: mark_conversation_read
tools.summary: Moves the caller's read marker forward to a message in this conversation and lifts the caller's unread mark.

tools.name: message_clients
tools.summary: Sends one message from the caller into each client's conversation and notifies the client like a chat message.

tools.name: move_workout
tools.summary: Moves a workout to another date (Calendar) or place (Fixed).

tools.name: parse_workout_text
tools.summary: Reads pasted workout text, one exercise per line like "Back squat 4x6 92.5kg, rest 120s" or "Bench press 3x8-10 @ RIR 2, tempo 3010", and matches each line to the exercise library.

tools.name: pause_client
tools.summary: Pauses a client.

tools.name: periodise_client_workouts
tools.summary: Repeats the chosen workouts on the same weekday for the next weeks, each week a step further: more weight, reps, sets, or RPE, with an optional deload week.

tools.name: periodise_program
tools.summary: Copies selected workouts forward week by week, progressing weight, reps, sets, effort, and deloads.

tools.name: preview_client_import
tools.summary: Classifies import rows without writing them.

tools.name: preview_plan_change
tools.summary: Previews a move such as +25 g carbs on the training and rest days: every food line that changes (old to new amount), the day totals before and after, and what could not be done.

tools.name: publish_automation_rule
tools.summary: Publishes an automation so it can enroll clients.

tools.name: push_program_changes
tools.summary: Replaces client copies of one placed workout with the program's current version and recomputes their day types.

tools.name: release_onboarding_draft
tools.summary: Writes sections of the draft to the client, as the releasing coach and through the same services as the coach's own screens: the phase, the meal plans linked to the training and rest day with their numbers and the training rhythm, the supplement lines (added to any plan the client has), the program, and the welcome message in chat.

tools.name: remove_form_question
tools.summary: Removes a question from new check-ins.

tools.name: remove_program_from_client
tools.summary: Takes a program off the client from a date on.

tools.name: remove_program_workout
tools.summary: Takes a workout off the program.

tools.name: reopen_checkin_due
tools.summary: Opens a missed or skipped check-in again until the end of closesOn.

tools.name: reorder_form_questions
tools.summary: Sets the question order.

tools.name: resend_invitation
tools.summary: Sends an invitation again with a fresh link.

tools.name: restore_client
tools.summary: Restores an archived client.

tools.name: resume_client
tools.summary: Resumes a paused client back to active.

tools.name: save_checkin_answers
tools.summary: Saves several answers of a draft in one call, or of a sent check-in the client may still change.

tools.name: schedule_workout
tools.summary: Adds one workout to the client: a copy of a library or program workout, or an empty one, on a date (Calendar) or place (Fixed).

tools.name: search_exercises
tools.summary: Searches the shared Evolvix exercises and your company's own by a substring of the name, sorted A to Z, with no relevance ranking.

tools.name: search_foods
tools.summary: Searches the food catalog: shared foods plus your company's.

tools.name: search_log_catalog
tools.summary: Searches what this client can log: foods first, then Open Food Facts products, as the company's food access allows.

tools.name: search_log_foods
tools.summary: Searches the foods this client can log: shared foods plus the company's, or only the company's when food access says so.

tools.name: search_off_products
tools.summary: Searches Open Food Facts products by name and brand, best match first.

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.summary: Searches recipes: your company's and the shared Evolvix set, with kcal and protein per serving.

tools.name: send_client_invitation
tools.summary: Emails an invitation to an invited client who has none, such as one added with access later.

tools.name: send_message
tools.summary: Sends a chat message.

tools.name: send_win_message
tools.summary: Congratulates the client on a win (a card from list_client_wins; the whole week is then handled) with a chat message from the coach.

tools.name: set_bloodwork_schedule
tools.summary: Sets when bloodwork is due for a client: everyWeeks (1 to 52) counts from the last panel, beforePhaseEndWeeks (1 to 26) asks for a panel that many weeks before a phase of their plan ends; with both, the earlier date counts.

tools.name: set_client_phase
tools.summary: Adds a phase to a client's timeline, or with phaseId changes that phase.

tools.name: set_client_week_timeline_cell
tools.summary: Sets what the coach typed in one cell of a client's week timeline, or clears it with an empty value so the derived value shows again.

tools.name: set_daily_targets
tools.summary: Sets one day type's calories and macros, or attaches mealPlanId, and keeps the other day types, their plans, and the weekday rules.

tools.name: set_day_override
tools.summary: Sets the day type of one date, overriding training and rules.

tools.name: set_day_rules
tools.summary: Replaces all weekday and date rules.

tools.name: set_everyday_targets
tools.summary: Sets the same targets for every day.

tools.name: set_life_mode
tools.summary: Starts a life mode for a client: kind travel, sick, holiday, competition or other (other needs a note), from startsOn (default today) to endsOn, both days included, at most 120 days.

tools.name: set_metric_goal
tools.summary: Sets the goal for one metric with a start and goal date.

tools.name: set_micronutrient_target
tools.summary: Sets this client's own daily target for one nutrient, by catalog key such as iron_mg, in the unit get_micronutrient_day shows (vitamin D in µg).

tools.name: set_nutrition_setup
tools.summary: Replaces the nutrition pattern for a relationship.

tools.name: set_stage_target
tools.summary: Sets the weight the coach wants on stage for the client's next show (or for showDate, which also makes that date a show), the weeks to leave out of the projection (skipDates: any day in a diet break or refeed calendar week; replaces the list) and whether the client sees the countdown card (showInApp).

tools.name: set_supplement_plan
tools.summary: Replaces a client's supplement plan from effectiveOn as a new version; earlier days keep the plan they had.

tools.name: set_training_mode
tools.summary: Sets the client's training mode (calendar or fixed) and permissions, as the Training settings page does.

tools.name: skip_checkin_due
tools.summary: Skips one upcoming or open check-in and schedules the next, or excuses a missed one so it stops counting against compliance.

tools.name: skip_workout
tools.summary: Marks a workout skipped.

tools.name: snooze_attention
tools.summary: Snoozes one attention reason for 1, 3, or 7 days.

tools.name: start_call
tools.summary: Starts a call with a client, or a check-in review with mode review, and returns it.

tools.name: start_checkin
tools.summary: Opens a draft for a due check-in, or an extra one on a form that allows it.

tools.name: start_switch_import
tools.summary: Starts the import.

tools.name: stop_enrollment
tools.summary: Stops one client's automation and cancels what is still scheduled.

tools.name: submit_checkin
tools.summary: Sends the check-in to the coach.

tools.name: suggest_targets
tools.summary: Suggests daily targets from bodyweight, goal, and activity.

tools.name: tag_clients
tools.summary: Adds and removes tags on many clients.

tools.name: test_automation_rule
tools.summary: Previews runs due in the next 14 days and the path through the flow.

tools.name: unarchive_exercise
tools.summary: Brings an archived company exercise back.

tools.name: unarchive_form
tools.summary: Makes an archived form editable and assignable again.

tools.name: unarchive_workout
tools.summary: Brings an archived company workout back.

tools.name: undo_switch_import
tools.summary: Takes a finished import back within 24 hours: deletes the clients it added and the measurements it wrote, unless the client has signed in, was invited, has activity, or a value was edited since.

tools.name: unlog_habit
tools.summary: Removes the log of one day.

tools.name: unskip_workout
tools.summary: Puts a skipped workout back on the calendar.

tools.name: update_automation_rule
tools.summary: Replaces an automation that is not archived, and leaving out the trigger, anchor, or settings resets them.

tools.name: update_checkin_schedule
tools.summary: Changes an assignment's schedule.

tools.name: update_client
tools.summary: Updates a client's names, dates, practice, or email.

tools.name: update_content_item
tools.summary: Edits a calendar item in place: the text, the title, the date (clearDate removes it) or the status (idea, draft, approved, posted).

tools.name: update_exercise
tools.summary: Replaces a company exercise.

tools.name: update_food_log_entry
tools.summary: Changes one entry.

tools.name: update_form
tools.summary: Changes the name, description, cover, default schedule, or sheetPreset (the Google Sheets tracker layout a check-in form syncs into; an empty string turns it off).

tools.name: update_form_question
tools.summary: Changes some fields of one question.

tools.name: update_habit
tools.summary: Updates a habit.

tools.name: update_lead
tools.summary: Changes a lead: status (a new status writes a timeline line; lost takes a lostReason), details, tags, a note for the timeline, and the coach (assignedCoachId or unassign, owners and admins only).

tools.name: update_meal
tools.summary: Renames a meal or changes its time or note.

tools.name: update_meal_option
tools.summary: Edits a dish: name, servings, foods, steps, or numbers by hand.

tools.name: update_program_details
tools.summary: Renames a program or changes its description, cover, tags, or type; send only the fields to change, with baseRevision from get_program.

tools.name: update_style_guide
tools.summary: Replaces all six parts of the caller's own style guide (each up to 2,500 characters, 8,000 in all).

tools.name: update_supplement
tools.summary: Replaces a supplement of the library, its product links and discount code included.

tools.name: update_switch_import_mapping
tools.summary: Replaces the column mapping and options (weightUnit kg or lb, lengthUnit cm or in, dateOrder dmy or mdy) of a draft and answers the new preview.

tools.name: update_task
tools.summary: Updates a task.

tools.name: update_workout
tools.summary: Replaces the whole workout as a new revision.

tools.name: use_form_template
tools.summary: Copies a platform template into the company as a form at revision 1.
